tools.name: describe_service
tools.description: Say what Vari8ion is, who it is for, its two services, the price, what it needs and what it keeps. Call it first if the client asks what this is.

tools.name: get_activation_steps
tools.description: Return every step to sign up one project, in call order, and what happens after the last step.

tools.name: start_project_link
tools.description: Start linking one project to Vari8ion. Returns the link_id, the price and the share steps for the client's cloud.

tools.name: get_share_steps
tools.description: Return the share steps for one account type, if the client's account differs from the one given at the start.

tools.name: set_contract_folder
tools.description: Record where the bid and contract folder is. It holds the tender or bid, the signed contract, its schedules and any amendments. Optional. It helps Vari8ion find the files faster.

tools.name: set_drawings_folder
tools.description: Record where the technical drawings folder is. It holds the drawings, their revisions and the drawing register. Optional. It helps Vari8ion find the files faster.

tools.name: set_daily_records_folder
tools.description: Record where the daily records folder is. It holds site diaries, daily reports, photos, dockets and timesheets. Optional. It helps Vari8ion find the files faster.

tools.name: set_correspondence_folder
tools.description: Record where the correspondence folder is. It holds emails, letters, RFIs and meeting minutes. Optional. It helps Vari8ion find the files faster.

tools.name: set_variations_folder
tools.description: Record where the variations folder is. It holds variation requests, instructions and change orders. Optional. It helps Vari8ion find the files faster.

tools.name: set_programme_folder
tools.description: Record where the programme folder is. It holds the programme or schedule and its updates. Optional. It helps Vari8ion find the files faster.

tools.name: get_link_status
tools.description: Show one link: the service, the folders given, whether it was sent, and the next call.

tools.name: send_project_link
tools.description: Send the share link to Vari8ion as a request. The one share link is all that is needed. Extra links and folder paths are optional. It can be sent once for each link_id.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
